title: Work-balance area diagrams
changes: Paired work-in/work-out diagrams encode distance as width and force as height using common scales.
Equal areas show equal work with readable force × distance products and joule totals.
Very thin rectangles retain exact proportions, with an explanatory note and numeric values.
Existing reading-level boundaries are preserved and system high contrast uses system colors.

validation.precision: SVG area equality is checked within 1e-7. Comparison with CSS bar ratios uses 1e-5 relative tolerance because CSSOM serializes percentage widths to six significant digits; the initial stricter absolute comparison was corrected after inspecting exact values.

nextOpportunities: Compact phone camera controls to bring pose inspection closer to the scene.
Save and compare two configurations with linked force and distance results.
Guided experiments that change one parameter and ask learners to predict the effect.
publication: Local only; no commit, push, or deployment
